description: Read the linked Rebase Cloud project's log once, the running app's or the latest build's (`rebase cloud logs`). `source: "runtime"` (the default) is what the app prints, `source: "build"` the latest deployment's build log. Never follows; pass `nextSinceTime` back as `since` to read on.

grep.description: Runtime only: keep lines containing this text (case-insensitive), or matching /regex/flags

level.description: Runtime only: keep lines at this severity or above

preview.description: A preview's name (or the id of the deployment that built it), to read its log instead of production's

previous.description: Runtime only: the previous, crashed instance of the container

since.description: Runtime only: a duration like 30s, 5m or 1h, or an RFC3339 time

source.description: runtime (default): what the app prints. build: the latest deployment's build log

name: rebase_cloud_logs
